svg.text: Performed experimental precedent for generated complete reactions
Selected cases; complete net chemistry, not experimentally established electron-arrow sequences.
K2CO3; THF/water; addition not exceeding30C; reported completion approximately20min; precipitation at20-25C
Example1: acid112.9g, thionyl chloride180.4g, THF600mL,25-30C,5h; then used in situ for coupling. No acid-chloride
isolated yield or independent characterization is given.
Pyridine 15 mL; aniline 5.14 g/25 mmol; acetyl chloride 2.3 mL/33 mmol added at 0 C, then reflux 1 h. Chromatography
gives 5.6 g, 90%; product NMR and GC-MS are reported.
Example 489 explicitly refers to Example 478: cesium carbonate (source notation CsCO3) in DMF, 60 C for 14 h, then
reversed-phase HPLC. The 33% yield belongs to Example 478's nitrobenzyl analogue and is NOT assigned to Example 489.
Source/training overlap unknown; an experimentally documented transformation is not a tested whole route.
